title: Google Local Service Ads: Get the Google Guaranteed Badge and Pay Per Lead

segments.text: STANDARD GOOGLE ADS CHARGE PER CLICK
segments.narration: Standard Google Ads charge you whether the person calls or not. LSAs only charge when they do.

The Google Guaranteed badge means Google will reimburse a customer up to $2,000 if they are unhappy with work booked through your listing. That is Google's money, not yours. That kind of backing gets clicks from customers who would otherwise hesitate to hire an unfamiliar contractor.
segments.explanation: Google reimburses customers up to $2,000 per job if unhappy with work booked through a Google Guaranteed listing

segments.text: PAY PER LEAD. NOT PER CLICK.
segments.narration: With standard Google Ads, a click to your site costs you $20 to $35 in home services. Most clicks don't convert. With LSAs, you only pay when someone actually calls or messages you directly. No contact, no charge. Mis-dials and hangups can be disputed for a credit.
segments.explanation: LSAs charge only when a potential customer calls or messages directly from the listing, not for clicks

segments.narration: Most home service trades see cost per lead between $10 and $25 on LSA. Standard Google Ads in competitive home service categories can push cost per lead to $130 to $350 when you account for click costs and conversion rates. That difference is not marginal. It changes whether paid search is profitable.
segments.explanation: Most home service trades see LSA cost per lead between $10 and $25, far below the $130 to $350 per lead from standard PPC in the same categories

segments.text: APPEARS ABOVE ALL OTHER GOOGLE ADS
segments.narration: LSAs don't compete with regular Google Ads for position. They appear in a different unit above everything else on the page. Above standard Google Ads, above organic results, above the map pack. That is the highest placement available in Google Search for a local service business.
segments.explanation: LSAs appear in a separate unit at the very top of search results, above standard Google Ads and all organic results

segments.narration: Two badge types exist. Google Guaranteed covers home service trades: plumbers, electricians, HVAC, locksmiths, roofers, house cleaners, and dozens more. Google Screened covers professional services like lawyers, financial planners, and real estate agents. Each requires background check, license, and insurance verification before your listing goes live.
segments.explanation: Home service businesses like plumbers and electricians qualify for Google Guaranteed. Professional services like lawyers qualify for Google Screened.

segments.narration: You cannot shortcut the approval timeline, but you can avoid making it longer. Background checks clear in 3 to 5 business days. License and insurance review adds another week. Total time from application to live listing runs 2 to 6 weeks. The main delay is incomplete documents. Upload everything in one session and you move through faster.
segments.explanation: Full LSA verification takes 2 to 6 weeks: background check processes in 3 to 5 days, then license and insurance review adds another week

segments.title: Average LSA Cost Per Lead by Service Category (2025)
segments.narration: Cost per lead varies significantly by trade and market. House cleaning and locksmith leads run around $11 to $12. Plumbing sits at $20. HVAC climbs to $35. Roofing can reach $55 or more. The categories with the highest CPL tend to have the highest job values, so the math still works out.

segments.text: RUN LSA AND GOOGLE ADS TOGETHER
segments.narration: You don't have to pick one. LSAs give you the top position with a simple setup. Standard Google Ads give you precise targeting by service type. Most serious local advertisers run both. Start with LSA to get the badge live and collect CPL data, then add Google Ads for high-value services where you want more volume.
segments.explanation: Most established local advertisers run both LSAs for the top placement and standard Google Ads for specific service targeting and additional coverage
